messages:
maria: PR opened with offline KMS->HSM migration guide. covers PKCS#11 plugin, systemd unit, iptables vs nftables notes, and airgap image mirroring. https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1234 :eyes:

lena: diving in. can you highlight the minimal steps for a quick rollback? ops will want that first.

maria: good call. added a "rollback" section at bottom with commands to restore software KMS and disable pkcs11 mapping. snippet:

maria: ```bash
# disable pkcs11 plugin
sudo systemctl stop redwood-hsm-plugin
sudo systemctl disable redwood-hsm-plugin
# revert kms config
/opt/redwood/bin/kms-config --set backend=cloudkms
systemctl restart redwood-agent
```

matt: minor doc nit: in the systemd unit example you reference `Restart=on-failure` but we should recommend `Restart=always` for air-gapped nodes so the plugin comes back after containerd restarts. also mention `RestartSec=5s`.

kira: on iptables vs nftables: we should add the explicit `--check` example so people don't accidentally duplicate rules. e.g.

kira: ```bash
# add NAT rule idempotently
iptables -t nat -C POSTROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j MASQUERADE || \n  iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j MASQUERADE
```

maria: added that + a short paragraph on nftables edge cases (debian bullseye uses nft by default, some installers translate iptables commands which break the rule counters).

infra-bot: quick check: link https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1234 contains a binary example `pkcs11.so` path referencing `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`. Confirm packaging team will provide that path in on-prem bundles.

matt: packaging will not guarantee that exact path. changed to `{{PKCS11_LIB_PATH}}` placeholder and note to replace during packaging. also added snap/os-package examples.

kira: added MTLS cert ordering note — chain order matters for our sidecar. snippet:

kira: ```text
# cert.pem should contain: leaf cert first, then intermediates, then root (optional)
cat leaf.crt intermediate.crt > cert.pem
```

lena: can we include a short checksum verification step for airgap bundles? ops used `sha512sum` in last install.

maria: done. added offline bundle verify example:

maria: ```bash
sha512sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.sha512
# prints OK or FAIL
```

docs-bot: please ensure cross-links to "private quickstart" and "onprem troubleshooting" are present. use relative links to avoid broken absolute URLs.

action items:
- lena: quick sanity review of rollback wording
- matt: confirm packaging placeholder for PKCS11 path
- kira: final MTLS/iptables examples
- maria: squash commits and ping docs-bot for link-check

lena: will review this afternoon. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — plan to merge tomorrow if no major concerns. :shipit:
